tool.name: RADAR-PD Utility: Model Campaign
tool.description: run reviewed structural or magnetic model starts with bounded resources
tool.command: touch '$result_bundle' '$console_output' && trap "chmod a+r '$result_bundle' '$console_output' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true" EXIT && #if $model_request_b64 and $model_request echo 'Supply exactly one reviewed request source' >&2; exit 1 #elif $model_request_b64 python '$request_decoder' '$inline_request' decoded-model-request.json && python /opt/radar-symmetry/ndip_model_campaign.py '$action' '$source_gpx' '$model_assets' decoded-model-request.json worker '$result_bundle' > '$console_output' 2>&1 #elif $model_request python /opt/radar-symmetry/ndip_model_campaign.py '$action' '$source_gpx' '$model_assets' '$model_request' worker '$result_bundle' > '$console_output' 2>&1 #else echo 'Supply one reviewed request source' >&2; exit 1 #end if

param.name: action
param.label: Reviewed model operation
param.option: Run a finite chunk of approved starts

tool.help: NOVA captures the exact source GPX, candidate catalog and approved finite search. Each independent start runs in a fresh process. The pool respects GALAXY_SLOTS, memory and container CPU quotas; absent allocation information permits one worker. Unstarted trials remain pending at the chunk deadline. Every result retains its disposition, source and protocol hashes. Only independently audited, qualified projects appear in the output collection. A low Rwp does not establish a structure. No model API credential, Galaxy key, Python script or network request is accepted as an input. Discovery and planning run separately in NOVA. NOVA can send the closed request as a sanitized base64 parameter, decoded into a bounded JSON data file. The same native validation applies; no per-chunk request upload is required. Existing uploaded JSON requests remain supported. Independent starts share only the CPU and memory allocated to their Galaxy job. NOVA separately limits concurrent batches across scans; visible host cores do not authorize additional native workers.
